integrity: Full all-parameter bijective proof and exact finite exhaustive multivariate checks, with a standalone Python 3 checker. Only same-model review; no independent external verification.
scientific_limitations: Partial self-inverse injections only; labelled ordered tuples, all finite sizes and positive arities; no statement for general inverse-monoid elements or unlabelled orbit classes. Earlier implicit formula in partial action literature cannot be excluded.
title: Joint domain and product-rank census of commuting partial involutions
